scope: Extension of baselines/v15/analysis/memory-map/memory-map.json for the question 'what must be true before any further USB flash'. Adds the physical chip bound, the SDK-vs-SMK execution layout contrast, the UI/synth ownership rows that v1 only partially covered, and the decode-coverage holes. Offline only: no device access, no flash, no OTA.

address_spaces.flash_physical: 0x00000000..0x000FFFFF - the SPI NOR actually fitted (1 MiB)
address_spaces.ram0: 0x01C00000..0x01C7FFFF - on-chip SRAM window used by stock firmware
address_spaces.sdram_window: 0x04000000..0x041FFFFF - declared by the SDK default layout; presence on this unit UNPROVEN
address_spaces.protocol: non-address markers for the OTA transport contract

evidence_confidence.OBSERVED: exact evidence with a partial boundary or unresolved ABI
evidence_confidence.BLOCKED: explicitly unsafe, refuted, or unproven - must not be used
evidence_confidence.REFUTED: an earlier candidate shown to be unusable

rows.type_owner: SPI NOR chip extent actually present on the unit
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Hard upper bound. No address >= 0x00100000 may ever be written.
rows.notes: Two independent 1 MiB forced-loader dumps and the v15 restore dumps are all 0x100000 bytes. Flash id 0x856014, device id 0xEA924.

rows.type_owner: boot header / uboot / layout prefix (device-specific)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: PRESERVE. Never overwrite. Not reconstructible from any package.
rows.notes: Package contents differ from live for every device; block 0 matches lfsr(CHIP_KEY) only.

rows.type_owner: JLFS header sector
rows.mutability_patch_policy: PRESERVE. Live form is plain ^ lfsr(0x132b).
rows.notes: Contains app_area_head, app.bin, cfg_tool.bin, PRCT, CODE, BTIF, AUTORIM, USRFLASH entries.

rows.type_owner: application area (the only region an app-only OTA may replace)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: WRITE ONLY through a validated package + rollback manifest, or through guarded sector restore.
rows.notes: sf4 cipher, base 0x4000, CHIP_KEY 0x980F. Verified byte-exact against the v15 clean baseline after decode.

rows.type_owner: tail metadata (static in package, dynamic on device)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: PRESERVE. Live tail data is not present in any package.
rows.notes: Later S1C packages end the app area at 0x9AD33; 0x9A833..0x9AD33 is version-dependent.

rows.type_owner: beyond-package region (user/preset/config data)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: PRESERVE. Never written by an app-only OTA or by the guarded restore.
rows.notes: Holds the four DX7 banks at 0xF4000..0xF7FFF and per-preset records from 0xF8000. Losing this destroys owner data.

rows.type_owner: official v15 application runtime window (file offset + 0x02000000)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Patch only inside reproducible, reviewed windows.

rows.type_owner: boot/reset, data copy and BSS-zero code
rows.mutability_patch_policy: DO NOT PATCH.
rows.notes: Sets sp=0x01c3a2d4, ssp=0x01c3b2d4, copies data to 0x01c00000, zeros BSS to 0x01c4651c.

rows.type_owner: storage raw read/write wrappers
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Call only with return==requested_length checks.
rows.notes: read_02004870 / write_02004b02. No CRC/memcmp ABI established.

rows.type_owner: stock selected-record loader and current-snapshot producer
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Do not bypass without preserving the stock lifecycle.
rows.notes: Copies the 0xa3 raw record then expands packed fields; destination is the current snapshot.

rows.type_owner: Note On/Off dispatcher (channel discrimination point)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Patch only at validated post-hook bytes.
rows.notes: r9==9 selects the Ch10 branch; copies 0x9c bytes to the per-voice destination.

rows.type_owner: Note Off / Note On voice-source copy sites
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Live-validated patch windows in S1C5/S1C6 lineage only.
rows.notes: 0x0201c63e Note Off source, 0x0201c67c Note On source; both already replaced in the installed S1C6 firmware.

rows.type_owner: S1C producer/selector and reset-signature detector
rows.mutability_patch_policy: S1C lineage owned; preserve SHA unless the slot ABI is rebuilt.
rows.notes: Only 2 bytes of slack remain. M09 proved this region must not be extended into an assumed code cave.

rows.type_owner: SysEx ingress and staging handler
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Do not use as durable storage.
rows.notes: Bulk and single-parameter paths; transport byte 161 doubles as the Yamaha checksum slot.

rows.type_owner: memcpy-like routine
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Call only under the established ABI.
rows.notes: 146 decoded callsites.

rows.type_owner: allocator / heap init region
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Do not claim heap ownership; arena bounds blocked.
rows.notes: heap_init / malloc_like / free_like observed without arena proof.

rows.type_owner: early init/boot-adjacent code region - 274 decoded functions, almost none mapped
rows.mutability_patch_policy: UNMAPPED. Contains real decoded code. Must not be treated as a gap or as free space.
rows.notes: Ownership per function is not established. 274 of the 684 recursively decoded functions sit in 0x02000000..0x02005000; the memory map names only the boot stub (0x02000000..0x020000A4), the storage wrappers (0x02004870..) and later anchors. This is the largest block of known-but-unowned code in the image and the only place the boot-to-main init chain (and therefore USB/board init) can live.

rows.type_owner: application main entry reached by the boot stub
rows.mutability_patch_policy: DO NOT PATCH.
rows.notes: Boot code 0x02000090: mov r6,#0x020020A0 ; goto r6. The code at main configures tick/frequency values (constant 0xf4240 = 1e6, 0x2dc6c00 = 48e6) and manipulates peripheral fields with base+offset addressing. This is the app-side clock/tick setup point; PLL/oscillator bring-up itself is upstream (uboot), which is why the original G-04 framing ("find v15 PLL init in the app") was probably the wrong question.

rows.type_owner: shared stock string/table blob (codec strings, JLFS/storage names, UI strings, dispatch tables)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Read-only reference data. Not a code cave.
rows.notes: Byte-verified: 0x02057250 = NUL-separated codec/extension strings (wav/lc3/aac/m4a/mp3...), 0x02057954 = "app_area_head", 0x02057d98 = UI strings ("9 Mono#/#C65050 Poly"), 0x0205785b = table containing code pointers (0x02040d6e/72/80), 0x02057f04 = table containing code pointer 0x0202c348. The USB descriptors live inside this same blob (0x020579ae interface, 0x02057ab0 CIN table, 0x02057b53 device descriptor, 0x02058274 jack graph). CORRECTION: the 12 functions that reference this range reference it overwhelmingly as STRINGS (e.g. FUN_02004a54 uses "app_area_head" = storage), so they are not USB anchors. No decoded instruction references any descriptor base, and no 32-bit pointer to one exists in the image.

rows.type_owner: the only three decoded functions that touch core SFRs (clock/SFC-controller candidates)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Candidate only. Function boundaries are partial (spans a range, not three exact extents).
rows.notes: A full immediate scan of the 51,089-row recursive listing finds only 7 SFR references in the whole image: FUN_020014ee (0x1eef300, 0x1eef100), FUN_0200152a (same pair), FUN_02003ef0 (same pair). These are the only clock/controller-configuration candidates found by the SFR axis. Caveat: pi32v2 immediates may be stored shifted, and most peripheral access is base-register + offset, so this axis is underexplored rather than exhausted.

rows.type_owner: UI state machine / render update (strong candidate)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Candidate only. No live validation. Do not patch yet.
rows.notes: ui-preflash REQ-02: setter-to-redraw path not closed; final LCD write unresolved.

rows.type_owner: grid/submode dispatch on state +0x302
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Candidate only.
rows.notes: Observed dispatch values 2..6.

rows.type_owner: object field +0x24 C-string setter
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Candidate only.
rows.notes: Reached from 0x02020376 with the 'Keys Channel-' descriptor at 0x02058314.

rows.type_owner: current Patch record save writer (strong candidate)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Candidate; the S1C7-S1C9 persistence attempts against this area all failed.
rows.notes: 0x02026d80..0x02026dd4 can become a callable leaf only after the SAVE branch at 0x02026d7a changes.

rows.type_owner: 11-entry internal callback vector
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Table existence only. No dispatcher/caller found; physical event IDs must not be promoted from this.
rows.notes: This is exactly the class of 'looks like a table, assume it is free/known' shortcut that M09 punished.

rows.type_owner: initialized data RAM (boot copy destination)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Stock RAM. Not free unless an owner is proven.

rows.type_owner: BSS / heap zero span actually reached by stock v15
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Not free by zeroing. Stack, globals, heap and task aliases must be excluded.
rows.notes: BSS zero size 0x3cb48.

rows.type_owner: RAM0 above the stock v15 high-water mark
rows.mutability_patch_policy: UNPROVEN. Zero evidence of ownership or absence of alias. Must not host an SDK app's data/bss/heap until proven.
rows.notes: M09 was lost to exactly this reasoning error: 'undecoded and zero' was treated as available.

rows.type_owner: SDK BOOT_INFO slot (BOOT_INFO_SIZE = 48)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: SHARED PLATFORM CONVENTION: the stock app itself populates this slot. Still device state - do not repurpose.
rows.notes: REFINED: boot code FUN_020000c6 at 0x020000c6 copies fields from the pointer passed in r0 into 0x01c7fd50 (+0x00, +0x10, +0x18, +0x1c, +0x1e, +0x20) - exactly the SDK BOOT_INFO_SIZE=48 slot. Six decoded sites reference 0x01c7fd50 in total. So the SMK boot chain and the SDK share this convention; the earlier "SDK-only, SMK chain does not write it" note was wrong.

rows.type_owner: SDK UPDATA_BEG update-flag region
rows.mutability_patch_policy: SHARED PLATFORM CONVENTION: stock code reads it at boot. Do not repurpose.
rows.notes: REFINED: the boot chain calls FUN_02007424 (0x0200008a) which references 0x01c7fd80, i.e. UPDATA_BEG is live in stock firmware, not an SDK-only slot.

rows.type_owner: main UI/Patch state object base (stock global)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Patch only via proven field offsets. Do not encode custom state.
rows.notes: Fields: +0x200 page, +0x302 submode, +0x309..+0x30f pending input, +0x3a0 bank presets, +0x3a4 selected bank, +0x129c dirty flags, +0x1a14 current Patch record.

rows.type_owner: current voice/patch snapshot (0xa3 raw record)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Mutable stock state. Safe only as a source at the instant of copy.
rows.notes: 0x9c dispatch prefix + 7-byte stock tail.

rows.type_owner: S1C 16-slot RAM envelope and Playback Note map
rows.mutability_patch_policy: VOLATILE, owned while S1C6 is installed. Re-sent after every reboot.
rows.notes: Producer stores wire byte 161 to 0x01c46f20 + slot.

rows.type_owner: SysEx staging complete-message window
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Transient. Never durable storage.
rows.notes: 0x9c payload plus F7.

rows.type_owner: boot stack initializer value range (sp/ssp/usp)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: No patch. Not a complete allocation map.
rows.notes: sp=0x01c3a2d4, ssp=0x01c3b2d4.

rows.type_owner: SDRAM window declared by the SDK default ('sdram') layout
rows.mutability_patch_policy: MUST NOT be used until SDRAM presence and controller bring-up on this unit are proven. The stock v15 app never addresses it.
rows.notes: The SDK default 'sdram' layout needs 2 MiB at 0x04000000. The official AC7911B8 datasheet shipped in the SDK (V1.0, 2021-12-10, section 4 'Package Type Specification') defines the part number as AC7911 + <chip/binding> + <memory code>, where the memory code is a single position: 0 none, 2/4/8/6/3/5/7 = 2/4/8/16/32/64/128 Mbit flash, A = 1Mx16 SDRAM, B = 4Mx16 SDRAM, C = 16 Mbit PSRAM, D = 64 Mbit PSRAM. The unit is marked C108221-11B8 and its flash measures 1 MiB = 8 Mbit, which is exactly memory code 8. An AC7911B8 is therefore an 8-Mbit-flash member, not one of the SDRAM/PSRAM members, and the SDk 4 MiB/2 MiB demo defaults are not this part. The stock v15 app never addresses 0x04000000 either.

rows.type_owner: flashed SDK app .data (the bricking build)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Evidence of the failure mode, not a usable region.
rows.notes: sdk.map: .data 0x04000000 size 0x988. app.bin SHA-256 5caaaf32... = the exact app inside the FWSC flashed 2026-08-15.

rows.type_owner: flashed SDK app .bss (the bricking build)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Evidence of the failure mode.
rows.notes: .bss 0x040009a0 size 0x2bb0.

rows.type_owner: flashed SDK app malloc heap
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Evidence of the failure mode.
rows.notes: _HEAP_BEGIN after .bss, _HEAP_END = 0x4000000 + SDRAM_SIZE - 32 = 0x041fffe0. Every os_task_create/malloc in app_main touches this window.

rows.type_owner: AC7911B8 part-number memory code (why this window is unavailable)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Evidence row. The window stays BLOCKED for placement.
rows.notes: Datasheet section 4: AC7911<chip><memory-code>; memory code 8 = 8 Mbit Flash. The forced-loader dumps independently measure a 1 MiB (8 Mbit) SPI NOR. The datasheet lists SDRAM/PSRAM as different memory codes (A/B/C/D) in the same single position, so this part is not an SDRAM member. Residual question is only whether an EXTERNAL DRAM die exists on the SMK PCB, which the existing FCC/owner photos can settle.

rows.type_owner: 256 KiB with zero recursive decode and <512 B/page exhaustive decode
rows.mutability_patch_policy: UNKNOWN CONTENT. Not data, not code, not free - simply unproven. No patch or storage may target it.
rows.notes: Exactly 64 pages. Contains the UI descriptor seen at 0x02058314 ('Keys Channel-') and the callback table at 0x02058248, so it is at least partly stock data.

rows.type_owner: page with zero recursive decode
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Unknown.

rows.type_owner: two pages with zero recursive decode
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Unknown.

rows.type_owner: runtime decode coverage measurement (not a placement row)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Measurement only.
rows.notes: Recursive decode covers 149,332 bytes = 24.2% of the window; exhaustive 325,010 bytes = 52.7%. 67 of 151 pages have no recursive decode at all.

rows.type_owner: normal-mode USB identity 4C4A:C755, MIDI interface 4, EP 0x04/0x84
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Read-only observation. Never rewrite descriptors in an app-only candidate without a live rollback proof.
rows.notes: Observed v15 runtime enumeration on this unit is 4353:cf4d, MIDI Streaming interface 4, EP 0x04/0x84. The in-image descriptor block is separately recorded in v2-usb-001. Do not filter a scan by a single VID/PID without first resolving which identity the installed build presents.

rows.type_owner: update-mode USB identity 4D4A:4155 (Jieli), MIDI interface 1, EP 0x04/0x84
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Entered only by the running app or by hardware recovery.
rows.notes: The SMK update mode is implemented IN the v15 application data, not in the boot loader.

rows.type_owner: verification completion request 0xE0000000 / 8 bytes
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Host answers with ASCII 'success' + NUL.
rows.notes: Stage boundary between the running app and the update loader.

rows.type_owner: stock USB-MIDI descriptor / string / class-table area (in-image bytes)
rows.mutability_patch_policy: These are the bytes an SDK app must reproduce for SMK identity. Do not edit in place without a live rollback proof.
rows.notes: Contains: USB device descriptor 0x02057b53 (VID 0x4353/PID 0x4b4d), MIDIStreaming interface 0x020579ae, CIN payload-length table 0x02057ab0, UTF-16LE product string 0x02057fa8, bulk EPs 0x02057fc6/0x02057fd6, 12-descriptor MIDI jack graph 0x02058274, and the 11-entry callback vector 0x02058248. Corroboration: evidence.md already probed runtime region 0x02057000..0x020584ff and this range has zero recursive decode in coverage.json - two independent methods agree it is data, not code.

rows.type_owner: in-image normal-mode descriptor identity: VID 0x4353, PID 0x4b4d
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Reference only.
rows.notes: Distinguish three different identities in the record: in-image descriptor 4353:4b4d; observed runtime enumeration 4353:cf4d (runtime-trace); macOS enumeration of the firmware-1.05 unit 4C4A:C755 (research notes). Resolve which one a given build will present before filtering a scan by VID/PID.

rows.type_owner: upgrade completion request 0xF0000000 / 8 bytes
rows.mutability_patch_policy: Host answers 'success' then the device reboots.
rows.notes: 1241 requests for a full 701,120-byte payload.
